correction_evidence.source: Deck the Halls comes from Nos Galan, a Welsh New Year's Eve song from the 1700s. The English words came in 1862.

correction_evidence.reason: Keep the prose title exactly consistent with localized Deck the Halls, framed by Dziesma to avoid inflecting a title. Preserve Welsh title Nos Galan, the full-century 1700 clarification and 1862.

correction_evidence.source: Folk songs and a spiritual everyone can sing, with simple chord charts to strum.
